exposure: Reader experience (experienced vs. inexperienced in pelvic MRI)
outcome: Interobserver agreement for diagnosis of deep infiltrating endometriosis
Interobserver agreement for diagnosis of endometriomas
Interobserver agreement in the assessment of compartments A, B, and C of the #Enzian classification
Intraobserver variability for compartments A, B, and C
cohort: 50 consecutive patients (mean age 34.9 +/- 8.6 years) who underwent pelvic MRI for evaluation of endometriosis between March and July 2023.
finding: The #Enzian classification, with sufficient reader experience, demonstrated excellent inter- and intraobserver agreement for MRI-based diagnosis of deep infiltrating endometriosis and endometriomas.
